The phone's camera app is closed first, because the two cannot use the camera together; a photo or a video from the Trials or Calibration page stops the live view and opens the camera app again. Without the bench: choose "Calibration board" in the panel, show it on a monitor (or print it) and point the phone at it.

link.btn.hint: Link to the phone, cable or Wi-Fi, and the live view on its screen
link.title: Phone
link.mode.usb.det: USB, the steadiest; the phone charges
link.mode.wifi.det: no cable; phone and PC on the same network
link.usb.note: Plug in the cable, turn on USB debugging (Developer options) and accept the request on the phone.
link.ready.note: If the Wi-Fi drops, the app reconnects by itself and the live view goes on.
link.pair.s1: Phone and PC on the same network. Not eduroam or other networks that keep devices apart: use the phone's hotspot or a router of the bench.
link.pair.s2: On the phone: Settings › Developer options › Wireless debugging: turn it on.
link.pair.s3: Tap "Pair device with QR code" and scan this code.
link.pair.qr.wait: Waiting for the phone to scan it
link.pair.or: Or tap "Pair device with pairing code" and type here the address and the 6-digit code the phone shows.
link.connect.note: Paired but not connecting? Type the address shown under "IP address & Port" on the Wireless debugging screen.
link.said.paired: Phone paired and connected over Wi-Fi
link.said.live_stopped: Live view stopped: start it again on the new link
link.cause.no_adb: adb is missing on this PC: install scrcpy (winget install Genymobile.scrcpy).
link.cause.no_device: No phone on the cable: plug it in and turn on USB debugging.
link.cause.unauthorized: Accept the debugging request on the phone screen.
link.cause.many_devices: More than one phone on this link: keep only one.
link.cause.offline: The phone does not answer on the cable: unplug it and plug it in again.
link.cause.timeout: The phone took too long to answer: try again.
link.cause.wifi_none: No phone on Wi-Fi yet: pair it with the steps below.
link.cause.wifi_connecting: Connecting to the phone over Wi-Fi.
link.cause.wifi_reconnecting: The Wi-Fi link dropped: the app is reconnecting by itself. Try again in a moment.
link.cause.wifi_lost: No phone on Wi-Fi: check that it is on the same network, unlocked, with Wireless debugging on.
link.cause.pair_code: Wrong pairing code: type the 6 digits the phone shows now.
link.cause.pair_failed: Pairing failed: open the pairing screen on the phone again and retry.
link.cause.unreachable: The PC cannot reach the phone. Same network? Networks like eduroam block this: use the phone's hotspot or a router.
link.cause.not_paired: This phone is not paired with this PC yet: pair it first.
link.cause.paired_no_connect: Paired. Now type the address shown under "IP address & Port" and press Connect.
link.cause.qr_timeout: Nobody scanned the code: make a new one and scan it from Wireless debugging.
link.cause.bad_address: Type the address as the phone shows it, like 192.168.1.23:37011.
link.cause.mdns_off: The PC cannot see the phone on this network: type its address by hand.
view.note: The phone shows the live AR full screen in its browser, over the same link. Start the live view on the Live AR page.
view.qr.note: Another phone or tablet on the same network: scan this code. For the phone that films, scan it before starting the live view, or press Open on the phone.
view.firewall: The first time, Windows may ask to let Python through its firewall: allow it on private networks.
view.said.opened: Live view opened on the phone
view.page.off_text: Start it in ImpactGuide, on the Live AR page.
view.page.lost: No answer from the PC: trying again
view.page.ended: This view has ended: open it again from ImpactGuide.

step.holder.title: Marker holder
step.holder.text: Mount marker holder {0} on the splint.
step.reposition.title: Start position
step.reposition.text.A: Put marker A in its start position with the jig, then take the jig off.
step.reposition.text.B: Seat marker B in its seats and check that it is home.
step.drape_on.title: Drape on
step.drape_on.text: Lay the drape over part of the face, clear of the marker, the spheres and the pendulum path. It stays on for the first photos and video after the impact.
step.ref_scan.title: Reference scan at {0}°
step.ref_scan.text: Pendulum hooked up, arm at {0}°, panels off. Scan and export: the file is picked up from the export folder.
step.pendulum.title: Pendulum
step.pendulum.turn: To turn the platter pull its pin, turn it and pin it again.
step.highspeed_start.title: Side video on
step.highspeed_start.text: Start the 240 fps side video, with the ruler in view.
step.release.title: Release
step.release.text: Raise the pendulum to the {0}° hole and release it by hand. Stop it on the rebound (no second hit) and hook it up high. Confirm right after: the time of the impact is logged.
step.highspeed.title: Side video
step.highspeed.text: Stop the side video and import it.
step.scan.title: Scan at {0}°
step.scan.text: Arm at {0}°, panels off. Scan and export: the file is picked up from the export folder.
step.spheres.title: Spheres and cap
step.spheres.text: All six spheres in the scans? Cap shift since the last reference, in mm: leave it empty if it is not measured yet.
step.photo.title: Photo at {0}°
step.photo.text: Arm at {0}°, panels on. Shoot from here, look at the photo, then keep it.
step.video.title: Video
step.video.text: Start the recording, lift the index plunger and sweep the arm from end stop to end stop ({0}° to {1}°) in about {2} s, stop the recording, then bring the arm back to {3}°.
step.drape_photo.title: Photo with the drape at {0}°
step.drape_photo.text: Drape on. Arm at {0}°, panels on. Shoot from here, look at the photo, then keep it.
step.drape_video.title: Video with the drape
step.drape_video.text: Drape on. Start the recording, lift the index plunger and sweep the arm from end stop to end stop ({0}° to {1}°) in about {2} s, stop the recording, then bring the arm back to {3}°.
step.drape_off.title: Drape off
step.drape_off.text: Take the drape off slowly, without touching the marker or the pendulum.
step.close.title: Close the trial
step.close.text: Second hit, new cap and notes, then close the trial: the log row is written.
step.ctl.capshift.note: Above the threshold the next trial starts with a reposition.
log.saved: {0} corrected; old value, new value, time and reason are in the audit trail
